nom: Garnier SkinActive Micellar Cleansing Water All-in-1 Cleanser & Makeup Remover

avis.texte: This has always been my go to makeup remover for everything! stubborn eyeliner, waterproof mascara, and im talking water-PROOF!! This does it every time for me

avis.titre: Excellent for Removing Product and for a Double Cleanse
avis.texte: I use this product to remove facial products and for a double cleanse in the evening. This product works very well. It removes the products with ease, and is great for a first cleanse. It is a great value for the money.

After months of continued use for taking off eye makeup, my eyelashes were thinning and I was getting consistent eye infections. I stopped using two months ago and my eyelashes are coming back and not one single infection. I would not recommend.

avis.titre: I love it ! I been using it for years .
avis.texte: It is an amazing make up remover and it cleans your skin very well.

I've never been one to have acne in all the years of my life and I'm 60 now. I started using this micellar water from Garnier and I really liked it because I heard micellar water was great for your skin. I started getting terrible breakouts and I didn't link it to the micellar water because I really didn't think that it would do that to my skin but it gave me horrible horrible horrible acne. I have some scarring left over from this wonderful treat. I've used a lot of things on my skin and I've never had any type of breakouts whatsoever until I used this product. I wanted to write this review so that others don't suffer through what I did. Perhaps it's okay for some skin types but as I mentioned I'd never had acne in my entire life except for a pimple here and there this stuff is horrible.
Removes makeup well, doesn't break you out, and I'm very acne-prone. Another plus is that it's safe to use with lash extensions because it doesn't contain oil.

I've gone through around 3 or 4 bottles of the jumbo size. This is great when I'm feeling lazy and don't want to bother with a cleansing oil or balm and just want to get stuff off my face. It won't do much for waterproof makeup, but that's fine with me. Great as a first cleanse. I absolutely love this stuff and will always have it on hand.

I thought I'd give this makeup remover a try since for years I've used Vaseline. I'm going back to using Vaseline. This product burns every time I use it. I really wanted to love it, since it seems so many people use it.
Never again will I buy this product it gave me a chemical burn

avis.titre: Yes, it's as great as they say
avis.texte: This product removes the makeup very easily and quickly. I really recommend this one because who wants to fight to remove makeup? Not I
this profuct had been continuously recommended to me and i finally decided to give a try! i have no regrets at all and will be repurchasing
I have dryer skin and dont use a lot of makeup. I had to go back to my normal store brand make-up remover because this didnt do much or anything at all really.

avis.titre: Formula changed? Now it's just glorified liquid soap
avis.texte: Used it on a cotton pad and while wiping it over my skin, it suds up like soap! I've never had micellar water do this before. Leaves an awful film on my skin. 2 stars because it took off some makeup. Shaking the bottle suds it up like soap!

avis.titre: Travel Bottle Fail, Not Good at Eyes
avis.texte: This is effective at removing face makeup, but doesnt do very well with mascara. Although it says it will remove mascara, the bottle also says not to get it in your eyes, which is quite tricky to do. My eyes have become sensitive and it does sting them. Furthermore, the travel bottle is designed exactly like the full size and leaked all over my luggage, staining my leather purse that was in there (it was inside another bag and leaked through). To top it off, the lid on the travel bottle cannot be removed to refill with my larger bottle, creating more unnecessary plastoc waste. Will not repurchase.

avis.titre: This product is not for combination or oily skin
avis.texte: This micellar water removes most makeup well but I need to follow up with another cleanser or I will have breakout on my T-Zone. This product would work best for normal to dry skin.

I love this miceller water!! I get the biggest size for a regular basis and the small one is great for travel. It works great; i use it every night! Works amazing with the garnier eco pads as well!! Oh, and nothing against ulta ( i love you ulta, dont be mad!) but it is wayyyy cheaper at target. Just saying!
It really takes off your makeup and feels super nice! if you have sensitive skin i highly recomend!

this micellar water from garnier is my go to!! it cleanses makeup off the skin with ease, doesn't leave a greasy/sticky residue, and removes every bit of stubborn, waterproof makeup and mascara!! i even use this product on days i need a quick skin refresh. it never feels greasy like it needs to be washed off and you'd be suprised at the amount of excess makeup, dirt, and oil end up on the cotton pad after use. takes off mascara with ease with no pulling or tugging at the eyelid and never leaves eyes burning or dry! highly recommened!
I absolutely love this micellar water! It removes all of my makeup, and cleanses my face! I highly recommend this product, 100%!

As someone who is quite breakout prone, this micellar water is one product that has become a solid part of my daily routine that has never done me dirty. Haha. I enjoy trying new makeup removers (cleansing oils, other micellar waters, etc.) but always come back to this.
I like this as sn eye makeup remover. Use it with reusable cloth.
This stuff was really good at removing makeup/dirt. I recommend using cotton rounds with this.
I have been using this product forever! I hate the typical oily makeup remover and this is anytning but oily! I love it!
I have dry, insanely sensitive skin. This is good for clearing makeup off my skin, and as a general face cleanser.
This micellar water is great for removing makeup! It's suitable for sensitive skin and doesn't leave my skin feeling stripped.

avis.titre: Please Be Aware - Ruined skin barrier
avis.texte: I usually don't make reviews that aren't helpful but wanted to leave one for this. If you have sensitive skin, please be aware of this product as this ruined my skin barrier. The first time I thought it was a sunscreen but after the second time, this is the only product that is the common denominator. Immediately, my face gets red and burns. Yesterday, it completely swelled up so please avoid if you can.
It removes makeup so easily and I have sensitive skin and this is the only one that doesn't Irritate my skin!

avis.titre: This product broke my skin barrier!!
avis.texte: This product cause an allergic reaction and broke my skin barrier after ONE use. Its the only new product I have introduced to my routine and I woke up with a broken skin barrier around my eyes, mouth and nose. My skin was red, bumpy, burning and itchy. I do not recommend use for those with a compromised skin barrier OR sensitive skin.

This is an awesome product. Simple and yet awesome. Gets the job done and does not irritate my skin or eyes. I did not know how much I liked it until I tried Neutrogena's micellar water. Boy did I regret it! Back to my HG. I just love it!!
I'm not the best at washing my face so this product is great for me and my sensitive skin
Takes off mascara and eye shadow easily without leaving any residue behind.
This did get my makeup off and what not, however, I did notice my skin texture going through it while on this. I guess my skin is a bit sensitive but it was ok.

Ruined my skin and life. Please read if you want to avoid the worst breakout of your entire life. Before using this product, I had beautiful, clear skin, almost perfect! with maybe 2 pimples around my cycle which would go away on their own. This broke out EVERY. SINGLE. INCH. of my face. My skin erupted with blackheads, whiteheads, HUGE cysts that were so painful that It was excruciating to wash my face. I went to dermatologists and for months i was put on antibiotics, steroid creams, EVERYTHING. NOTHING worked. It was an emotional rollercoaster that left me with permanent purple acne scars all over my face. It was so bad that people asked me if it's contagious. I couldn't figure out what was wrong I never would have thought a micellar water would cause this. I ran out of it and never bought it again and my skin cleared within 2 weeks. I then used it once again, just to track where the breakouts were coming from, and boom, Instant painful cysts in 2 days. Please guys. Stay far away from this !!!!! So many reviews said the SAME thing what are they putting in this?!
Love this product ! I pour it into a spary bottle to minimize the amount that i use and it helps me last longer. It helps with removing makeup and it brightens my face.
Love this product ! I pour it into a spary bottle to minimize the amount that i use and it helps me last longer. It helps with removing makeup and it brightens my face.
I normally use Bioderma and wanted to try out this once since it was cheaper. I found it to be irritating around my eyes, so I'll be going back to Bioderma.

I have been wanting to buy this for a while and when I tried it was actually really good. It is cheap and it gets the work done. I really recommend this product. I am for sure buying more when this one finishes.

avis.titre: it's ok, but it's not the best
avis.texte: this product is ok, but i should have gotten an different one. i wear waterproof mascara a little bit to add a little bit more length on my lashes at the end of my routine. when i use this with regular mascara and a tiny bit of waterproof, the product does help to get it off. but when i use a full coat of waterproof mascara, it makes it difficult. i know i should have gotten the other one that takes waterproof makeup off but other than that this products great!

avis.titre: There's better micellar waters out there
avis.texte: I used to really like this, but ever since i discovered the bioderma micellar water, i havent looked back. It burns my eyes, it doesnt do a good job at taking off my mascara, and it leaves a gross filmy feel afterwards.

Been buying this on repeat for a while. Takes off makeup well, even waterproof mascara. I think this in combination with a face wash has helped clear up my acne! It's cheap and it works as well as the expensive version I bought before. My one thing is after a while it starts to smell funny (maybe needs refrigerated?). Overall great!
It smells like mold or mildew - both in the bottle and when applied to my skin. I kept trying to use this on and off for three months but the smell irks me.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: This takes off my makeup perfectly and doesnt make me break out
Gets off all makeup including waterproof and glittery! Make sure to wash face after since it is oil based!
ive been using this for so long. also if u get it in ur eyes it doenst burn a bit. perfect for all skin types i love it a lot. it takes off all my makeup and mascara. also cleanses my face well
Micellar water is the best for removing makeup second time repurchasing!

avis.titre: Quick Complete cleaning with refreshing results
avis.texte: I'm a MUA student. I needed something that worked correctly, simply, and completely. I came across All in One. Best idea. My skin feels amazingly fresh. It looks soft. All in One also removed makeup from days ago. I have washed & washed to no avail trying to get the professional makeup off. Now, Im a customer of this product loyally.

Giving this a 1 star rating because the last 2 times I've used it my face broke out in like hives almost, caused the skin under my eyes to swell and become very raw, my whole face was burning hot to the touch, I had raw places all over my face with flaky skin kind of like eczema it also itches like crazy my entire neck is itchy I'm normally not allergic to ANYTHING but I've saw other reviews that this happens to other women too that have used this product we need to get to the bottom of this to find out why it's happening and what kind of crazy ingredients are in this stuff making our skin react like this!!
good product. Very mild solution but removes makeup well. I would buy again.

In that case, after using my cleanser, I follow with my Garnier micellar water which you will not believe how much makeup residue is left on the cotton pad! Garnier micellar takes everyone off and makes my skin squeaky clean.

avis.titre: The Best Make-up Remover and Cleanser
avis.texte: I wear make-up daily, so I needed a really good make-up remover and cleanser. I've used several make-up removers over the years, but I wanted something different. About three weeks ago, I decided to try Garnier Water Rose Micellar Cleansing Water. OMG!! It removes all the make-up and any residue. This cleanser leaves my face smooth, hydrated, and very soft. Such a refreshing feeling! This is now my go-to make-up remover and cleanser. Love it!!♥️
